tools.name: scan_contract_selectors
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) deterministic EVM bytecode inspector that extracts 4-byte function selectors and flags privileged backdoors (transferOwnership, upgradeTo, mint, selfdestruct). Queries live RPC for chain_id (8453 Base, 84532 Base Sepolia, 42161 Arbitrum) unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is supp

tools.name: check_token_honeypot
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) static DEX token bytecode scanner that detects blacklist traps (isBlacklisted, setBlacklist), 100% sell-tax modifiers (setTax, setFee), trading freezes (pause), and SELFDESTRUCT opcodes. Fetches live token_address bytecode on chain_id unless bytecode_override (0x hex) is provide

tools.name: scan_dao_proposals
tools.description: Stage 1 Free ($0.00) governance scanner that fetches up to limit (1-20) recent Snapshot DAO proposals for space_id (e.g. arbitrumfoundation.eth, aavedao.eth, ens.eth) and extracts on-chain target addresses and calldata to spot hostile takeover payloads. Queries Snapshot GraphQL API by default, or fa

tools.name: deep_semantic_audit
tools.description: Stage 2 Paid ($0.05 USDC via x402 on Base Mainnet) hybrid audit combining Stage 1 on-chain gatekeeping with Stage 2 Gemini LLM evaluation to verify proposal_description claims against target_address bytecode and calldata under policy_prompt. Non-idempotent due to LLM evaluation and single-use EIP-30
